name: OUTY
description: Agent ID NFT mint (Phase 1). The NFT launch is the market test; the OUTY token comes later (Phase 2) and will be distributed by snapshot of NFT holders. Free phase: the first 1,500 Agent IDs mint 1 NFT each for a 0.0001 BNB service fee. Paid phase: 0.003 BNB per NFT, max 10 per Agent ID, cap 15,000. All mint proceeds are forwarded to the payee inside the mint transaction. No owner, no pause, no upgrade, no withdrawal function.
verified: Both contracts are verified on Sourcify with exact match (creation and runtime).

agentActions.checkStatus: call status() on the NFT contract; returns (phase, freeSold, paidSold, minted, priceWei, freeFeeWei, startUnix, freeEndUnix, freeRemaining, paidRemaining). phase: 0=pending, 1=free phase, 2=paid phase
agentActions.mintFree: contract call mintFree() on the NFT contract with value exactly 100000000000000 wei (0.0001 BNB); requires the calling wallet to hold a Binance Agent ID; 1 per Agent ID; only during the free phase
agentActions.mintPaid: contract call mintPaid(qty) on the NFT contract with value = qty * 3000000000000000 wei (0.003 BNB each); max 10 per Agent ID in total; only during the paid phase
agentActions.checkMine: call freeMintedOf(address) and paidMintedOf(address) on the NFT contract, or freeMintedById(agentIdUint256) / paidMintedById(agentIdUint256)
agentActions.listOnMarket: seller approves the market contract for the tokenId (approve or setApprovalForAll), then calls list(tokenId, priceWei) on the market contract
agentActions.buyOnMarket: call buy(listingId) on the market contract with value = listing price exactly; the NFT moves directly from seller to buyer, 2.5% fee to the payee

phase2Token.distribution: By snapshot of OUTY NFT holders at token launch. Planned entitlement: 30,000,000 OUTY per NFT held. Planned supply 1,000,000,000,000 fixed: free-mint NFTs 45,000,000 (1,500 x 30M), paid NFTs 450,000,000 (15,000 x 30M), liquidity pool 360,000,000, remainder burned.

safety: Minting never requires approvals, permits, or allowances. The mint value must match exactly or the contract reverts. Listing on the market requires the seller's own approval of the market contract for that NFT.
